name: ♥ri no Natsuyasumi ~Oji-san Kansatsu Nikki~
original_name: ♥りの夏休み～おじさんかんさつにっき～
source:
It's summer vacation for twin lolita-esque rural country girls!

Sadistic free spirit Ruka-chan, taciturn shy girl Hina-chan, and dirty uncle-like "Oji-san" have a hot wet summer of experimental c*ck and perversity!?

It's all deliciously detailed in Oji-san's Diary of Summer Loli.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093698.html]Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
双胞胎萝莉风乡村少女的暑假来啦！

抖S自由奔放的瑠香酱、沉默寡言的害羞日奈酱，以及像色大叔一样的“欧吉桑”，一起度过了一个充满试验性肉棒和变态行为的火热夏天！？

这一切都详尽地记录在欧吉桑的《夏日萝莉观察日记》中。
